speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a concerning rash and recent health changes. To help me understand what is happening, can you tell me when the rash first appeared and if it started on a specific part of your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. Regarding the arthritis medication you started recently, what is the specific name of the drug, and did you notice any fever, joint swelling, or shortness of breath alongside the rash? Also, have you had any recent travel or sick contacts?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced hypersensitivity syndrome (DRESS) secondary to antirheumatic medication. REQUEST TEST: Liver function tests, Complete Blood Count, Serum drug levels. REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatology photo of the rash and mucositis.
